title: PackResolutionPacket
description: What the DETERMINISTIC resolver decided, and why, for one mission. Every selection is a promoted pack named by its exact version hash; every non-selection carries a machine-readable reason code. Ranking is by declared priority and version hash only - never by a model's opinion that a pack sounds relevant, which is the failure mode this packet exists to make impossible to hide. The packet records a DECISION about which packs may run; it is not evidence about artifacts and can never change a check status.

requested.description: The lane the mission asked for. Supplied by the facade from a TaskPacket, never by a browser choosing a pack.

outcome.description: RESOLVED means the WHOLE plan resolved: every eligible pack is placed and unmet_contracts is empty - a partial plan is never RESOLVED. BLOCKED means part of a plan exists but a needed contract has no producer; a PackNeed is raised naming it, and the composition is display, not permission to run. NEEDS_HUMAN_CHOICE and NO_COMPATIBLE_PACK are deliberately distinct. Ambiguity means a person picks between named candidates; no compatible pack means there is nothing to pick from and a PackNeed is raised. Collapsing them would let 'we could not decide' read as 'we cannot do this'.

composition.description: The ordered plan, derived from typed handoffs: each step's produced contract is the next step's accepted contract. Built by graph construction, not by a model choosing an order.

selected.description: Promoted pack versions eligible for this lane. A pack appears here only after promotion, evaluation, integrity, skill, capability, inspector AND lane-compatibility checks all passed.

rejected.description: Every pack version that was considered and not selected, with the reason. Present so a member can be told why a capability they expected is absent, rather than seeing an empty plan.

conflicts.description: Ambiguity a deterministic rule cannot settle. Two packs producing the same contract is the canonical case: guessing which wins is how a composition starts depending on dictionary ordering.

unmet_contracts.description: Contracts the composition needs and nothing promoted produces. This is what a PackNeed is built from.

pack_need_id.description: Set when the resolver raised a PackNeed. Null otherwise; the resolver never builds an agent, calls a model or improvises a step in its place.
